name: Neige
source:
"Alright, Neige finished all their work for the day. Now Neige can go play!"

One of the servants at the Sweet Clown castle, a lovable airhead.
They stand out not only because of their donkey mask, but also because of their eccentric personality.
They like to bury all kinds of things.
